What is your favorite place here?
And you? What do your children like doing?
They get on well, don't they? Mine never stops.
Mine too! My son likes running everywhere.
How old is he?
He is eight. And my daughter is six — she likes drawing more than running.
Ah, a quiet one. Mine would draw on the walls if I let him.
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say that again, more slowly?
Sorry. My son draws on the walls of the house. Not on paper.
Oh! Mine too, when he was four. Do they come to this park often?
Every day after school. There is swimming on Wednesday, if yours likes water.
He does. He likes swimming a lot. Is it far?
Two minutes, next door. It is fun, and it is free.
That is good to know. And you? What do you like doing, when they are playing?
Honestly? Nothing. I sit here and I do nothing, and it is the best part of my day.

People always ask me if the three of them like the same things, and the answer is no, never. My oldest likes reading, and she reads in the car, in the kitchen, everywhere, which is wonderful until you want her to help with something. The middle one likes swimming, and only swimming: he does not like drawing, he does not like football, he does not like sitting still for two minutes. And the little one likes doing whatever the other two are doing, which is the easiest and the most difficult at the same time. What do I like? I like walking. Not running, not the gym: walking, alone, early in the morning, before anybody wakes up. My wife says that is boring, and she is probably right, but it is twenty minutes when nobody asks me anything. And that is my answer.

Hello, this is a message from Green Park about the activities for children next week. There are two changes, so please listen. The drawing session on Monday moves from three o'clock to four o'clock, because the tent is not free before that. Everything else stays the same. And the swimming on Wednesday is cancelled this week, because the pool is closed for cleaning; it comes back the week after, at the normal time. Two new things, as well. On Thursday afternoon we start a small music class for children who like singing, at three, and it is free like everything else. And on Saturday, after the story time, the children can stay and play football on the small field. Please remember that the playground is open every day until dark, with no booking and no cost. Thank you.
